ITEM.PTXT: When the seat belt control computer receives a pre-crash seat belt operation request signal from the distance control computer assembly or the ABS & traction actuator assembly (skid control computer), it operates the internal motor drive circuit to retract the seat belt.
If a collision does not actually occur even though the pre-crash seat belt has operated, the motor is rotated in reverse to return the belt to its tension before operation.
The seat belt control computer detects system malfunctions in 2 ways: a primary check and a constant check.
When a malfunction is detected in the system, a warning is displayed in the combination meter.

ENTRY.PTXT: Performed for 3 seconds when the power is turned ON (IG ON). During the check, the PCS indicator light in the combination meter illuminates. If there is no malfunction, the light turns off and the pre-crash seat belt becomes ready to operate.
After the primary check is completed, the diagnosis circuit in the seat belt control computer constantly checks the system for malfunctions.

ITEM.PTXT: By switching to the diagnosis mode, the diagnosis result for the malfunction location can be displayed by the number of times the indicator light blinks. In addition, a new diagnosis function has been adopted, and the diagnostic trouble code for the malfunction location can be read by connecting a diagnostic tool to DLC3. For details on the diagnosis mode, refer to the Repair Manual.
